k.q: Trace an adjacent comparison of two file sizes in a bubble-sort pass.
k.code:
leftGB = 6
rightGB = 1
if leftGB > rightGB then
    print("Swap")
endif
p: Write the three assignments needed to swap the original sizes safely. Why is sorting different from calculating their combined storage?
k.a: 6>1, so Swap prints. With leftGB=0 there is no output. To exchange the original values: temp=leftGB; leftGB=rightGB; rightGB=temp. Sorting reorders file sizes; total storage requires adding them: 6+1=7 GB.
